name: option-group
title: OptionGroup
description: One option group of a product: its name, a required tag, a rule such as a maximum, and the choices as equal-width chips or as radio or checkbox rows. Owns the group contract: required groups cannot be emptied, choices past the maximum and sold-out choices disable, and on an exclusive optional group a none choice clears it. The name, required tag and rule reach assistive technology.
